summary: OrderVault MVP first-pass testing complete. Backend: 5/5 pytest tests passed (root, health, OCR valid image, OCR data-URI prefix, OCR invalid payload graceful). Frontend: Home layout renders correctly (OrderVault header, search bar, 2 filter chip rows, 3 summary cards, empty state with CTA), 4 bottom tabs navigate correctly, Add Order form fills+saves and card appears on Home with correct Flipkart accent stripe / product / status badge / ₹499 formatting, search + platform-chip + status-chip filters work, tapping card opens /order/[id] detail with timeline, Mark Delivered updates status and shows 'X days left to return' banner (7 days left to return by Aug 11, 2026 - verified), Analytics tab renders bar chart + donut pie (2 SVGs) with platform breakdown, Settings Dark radio visibly switches theme (screenshots confirm), Clear-all-orders requires two taps (first shows 'Tap again to confirm', second clears + toast 'All orders cleared') and Home returns to empty state.

ui_bugs.issue: After Save Order / Mark Delivered, the toast modal briefly overlays the bottom tab bar and intercepts tab taps for ~1s. On web preview this made get_by_text tab clicks fail with 'Element is not visible'. Consider pointerEvents='box-none' on the toast backdrop, or shorter dismiss timeout, so navigation isn't briefly blocked.

issues: Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — coming from a library / inline styles. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Make ToastModal non-blocking (backdrop pointerEvents='box-none' or shorter auto-dismiss) so bottom tabs remain tappable during the toast animation.
OPTIONAL: Silence deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) — likely inside a shared component's inline style; migrate to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing returns HTTP 500 — acceptable, but consider 503 for clarity.
server.py is small (~175 lines), clean, MongoDB _id not exposed (no CRUD returning docs).
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly (process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) in add.tsx.

All interactive elements have proper testIDs (platform-select-<lower>, category-pill-<lower>, status-pill-<slug>, save-order-btn, mark-delivered-btn, theme-dark-row, clear-all-row, home-search-input, platform-chip-<lower>, status-chip-<lower>).
Bottom-tab tabBarTestID is present in _layout.tsx but not queryable on Expo web preview — expected limitation; text selectors work fine.
seed_data_creation: No DB seeding — storage is AsyncStorage (local). Tests created two orders (Wireless Mouse Flipkart ₹499, Kindle Amazon ₹1200) during UI runs; cleared at end via Clear-all-orders.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend OCR endpoint takes ~5-6s per call with Gemini vision — use timeout>=90s. Frontend uses AsyncStorage (no DB), so between test runs previous orders may persist for the same browser session; navigate to Settings → Clear all orders (two taps) to reset. Platform chip testIDs are lowercase: platform-chip-flipkart / platform-chip-amazon / platform-chip-all. Status chip testIDs: status-chip-ordered / status-chip-all etc. Add-order platform buttons: platform-select-flipkart etc. Bottom-tab tabBarTestIDs (tab-home, tab-add, tab-analytics, tab-settings) are NOT queryable on Expo web preview — use page.get_by_text('Home'|'Add Order'|'Analytics'|'Settings').first, but note that toasts briefly block tab clicks after save actions — fall back to page.goto('/add' etc) when a toast is visible.
